The main takeaway from our work is that
plants have multiple lines of defense against bacterial attack, and these are activated in response to different components of the pathogen, which may be expressed at different stages of infection.
plants have multiple mechanisms to counteract bacterial attack, and the pathogen has to overcome these defenses to cause disease.
the plant immune system is complex and is finely controlled by pathogens, and the plant response is not always effective in protecting plants against bacterial infection.
